$comment: B7, tier 1 (docs/CODE_PROVENANCE_REVIEW_2026-09-28.md §5.3; D144): the disposition of every run of 50 tokens or more that Papeleria's own code shares with an installed package, as scripts/similarity-scan.mjs reports it. An entry covers the regions it names, by their identity (the first 16 hexadecimal digits of the SHA-256 of the shared tokens, which the scan prints), between its own file and a corpus path starting with its prefix. A new region, even between the same two files, has no entry and fails the scan until someone decides it: replaced by an import, declared and attributed, or a false positive, with the reason. A named region the scan no longer finds fails it too. The run behind these entries is recorded in docs/evidence/provenance-2026-09-28.md.
